title: Step-level owner columns, links and cross-record step dependencies
goal: Each step shows whether a person must run or decide something, with a link, and what it waits on.
acceptance: Committed tests fail before the change
Procedure/Decision columns with 🧑‍🔧 / 🤔 and ownerLink; summary faces match; readers accept old and new faces
Cross-record step dependencies appear in Depends on / Unlocks and in the waiting step's status; check:work reports missing links and record-level dependencies
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: table columns, a link field, step-derived dependency cells and three readers.
